items.title: American Express (AXP) Could Be 30% Undervalued As Trust Questions Meet ETF Outflows
items.summary: ETFs were net sellers of American Express (AXP) on Monday, with about US$19 million of outflows led by the SPDR Dow Jones Industrial Average ETF. This interrupted a brief inflow streak into the card issuer. American Express has seen momentum cool, with the share price down 7.4% over the past 90 days and 16.5% year to date to US$311.11.
